sentences.en: I've made peace with my maker. I'm ready to die.
sentences.zh: 我已经接受了命运。我准备好了去死。

sentences.en: I broke the carafe that goes to the coffee maker.
sentences.zh: 我把咖啡机上的水壶打碎了。

sentences.en: The new coffee maker is faster than the old one.
sentences.zh: 新的咖啡机比旧的快多了。
